content.value_statement: Teams waste time rebuilding design decisions across products. This skill generates consistent tokens, responsive scales, and handoff notes from a brand color.
actual_capabilities: Generates primary, secondary, neutral, semantic, and surface color palettes from one brand color.
Creates typography scales with font families, weights, line heights, letter spacing, and text styles.
Builds an 8pt spacing system with numeric and semantic token names.
Creates sizing, border, shadow, animation, breakpoint, and z-index tokens.
Exports generated tokens as JSON, CSS variables, or SCSS maps.
limitations: It expects valid hex color input and may fail on malformed color values.
It does not create visual components, Figma files, or design mockups.
It does not run automated contrast or accessibility audits.
Typography and border choices are limited to modern, classic, and playful presets.

use_cases.title: Start a new token system
use_cases.description: Generate a complete token foundation before building interface components.

use_cases.title: Prepare implementation assets
use_cases.description: Export CSS variables or SCSS maps for direct use in a web project.

use_cases.title: Standardize design decisions
use_cases.description: Create shared spacing, type, and color scales for a growing product team.

output: A web-ready token export organized by color, type, spacing, and component sizing.

output_examples.input: Summarize a classic token system for #334155.
output_examples.output: The response lists palette groups, typography categories, spacing counts, shadow styles, and available export formats.

best_practices: Start with one approved brand color before generating a full token system.
Review generated semantic colors before using them for product states.
Choose the export format that matches your implementation workflow.
anti_patterns: Do not mix generated spacing tokens with unrelated spacing scales.
Do not treat generated colors as accessibility-approved without contrast checks.
Do not change exported tokens manually without updating the source token decision.

faq.question: What does this skill generate?
faq.answer: It generates design tokens for colors, typography, spacing, sizing, borders, shadows, animation, breakpoints, and z-index values.

faq.question: Which export formats are supported?
faq.answer: The script supports JSON, CSS variables, SCSS maps, and a summary output.

faq.question: Does it create UI components?
faq.answer: No. It creates token foundations and component sizing values, but not finished visual components.

faq.question: Can I use it with Claude or Codex?
faq.answer: Yes. The metadata lists Claude, Codex, and Claude Code as supported tools.

faq.question: Does it check accessibility automatically?
faq.answer: No. You should test contrast, focus states, and motion preferences before shipping.

faq.question: What inputs should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide a hex brand color, a style preset, and the desired export format.
